On 16 December 2023, GoodDollar was exploited on Ethereum Mainnet through a reentrancy vulnerability in the GoodFundManager contract. The attacker used a malicious staking contract to repeatedly reenter critical mint/burn operations, extracting about $2 million in DAI and G$ tokens. The GoodFundManager contract lacked both input validation on supplied staking contract addresses and a reentrancy guard on its collectInterest() function. This enabled an attacker-controlled contract to reenter mint/burn logic during a callback, inflating withdrawals from the reserve.
